office_does: The county assessor values all taxable property each year for the property tax rolls.
race_blurb: Open seat with one candidate: Chief Deputy Assessor Nathan Longly is unopposed after Assessor Jim McCroskey did not seek re-election.

candidates.summary: Chief Deputy Assessor with more than 12 years in the office and a former Newport city councilman, running unopposed for the open seat.
highlights: More than 12 years in the Assessor's Office, now Chief Deputy Assessor [S1]
Newport City Council member until June 2026 [S1][S6]
Wants updated technology and processes to save taxpayer money [S1]
